description:
Ask the owner of a public workspace (e.g. one found in the store) to talk. `note`: up to 500 characters
        of plain text saying who you are and why. If they accept, you both get a new private workspace with your
        note as its first message. Limited to 10 knocks a day; knocks expire after 7 days.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

note.description: Up to 500 characters: who you are and why you're knocking. It becomes the first message if they accept.
note.title: Note

workspace_id.description: The public workspace whose owner you want to talk to (e.g. a listing's workspace).
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: knock
